jobs.title: Director, Digital Storefront Performance & Insights
jobs.description:
Reporting to the Global Head of Digital Content Delivery, the Director, Digital Storefront Performance & Insights
will lead the measurement, performance intelligence, reporting and insights function for Manulife's Global Digital Storefront.

This role is accountable for Digital Storefront's end-to-end performance intelligence, from establishing measurement before launch and driving daily oversight through hypercare, to enabling continuous optimization and demonstrating enterprise-wide performance and value realization.

This strategic leader will define how Digital Storefront measures success, lead and orchestrate cross-functional teams responsible for delivering integrated performance intelligence and own the development and continuous evolution of a centralized Power BI dashboard that enables self-service reporting across Global and Segment teams.

Combining strong technical acumen with strategic business leadership, the Director will partner with Measurement & Insights, Strategy & Transformation, Business Architecture, the AI & Data Office, Technology and Segment Product Owners to shape and deliver the data, integration and reporting capabilities underpinning Digital Storefront's performance intelligence strategy. By connecting multiple sources of data, the Director will establish a holistic view of customer experience, digital journeys, acquisition, engagement, conversion, accessibility, site health and application monitoring, driving urgency and accountability to translate insights into timely action and measurable improvements.

A critical aspect of this role is demonstrating the ongoing value created through Digital Storefront, including its contribution to lead generation and conversion across the broader customer journey, as well as AI-enabled transformation. Working closely with Strategy & Transformation, the Director will identify meaningful measures, establish data capture and reporting mechanisms, and contribute to credible value models aligned with enterprise methodologies. While Strategy & Transformation leads the overarching value realization framework, the Director will play a central role in evidencing and continuously communicating Digital Storefront's value story through compelling, data-driven executive reporting.

Position Responsibilities

Performance & Measurement Strategy
Define and own Digital Storefront's measurement strategy and KPI framework, establishing consistent methodologies, baselines, targets and reporting standards across Global and Segment teams
Establish integrated measurement across customer experience and satisfaction, customer journeys, acquisition, engagement, conversion, accessibility, site health and operational performance
Partner with Measurement & Insights, Business Architecture, AI & Data Office, Technology to define and deliver the data architecture, integrations and capabilities required to deliver trusted, actionable performance intelligence, ensuring alignment with enterprise data governance and ownership standards
Partner with Strategy & Transformation, Measurement & Insights and Segment teams to define and implement measurement approaches that demonstrate DSF’s contribution to lead generation and conversion across the end-to-end customer journey, including first-touch, last-touch and multi-touch attribution.
Act as the business steward for Digital Storefront performance data, defining measurement requirements, business definitions, data quality expectations and downstream reporting needs, while partnering with the AI & Data Office and respective data owners to ensure the required data is captured, governed and made available for reporting and insights
Embed measurement requirements into experience and capability delivery, ensuring the right data is captured from the outset and shared downstream to support Segment-level measurement, optimization and value realization
Performance Intelligence, Power BI & Reporting
Lead the cross-functional team responsible for delivering Digital Storefront's performance intelligence, analytics, measurement and reporting capabilities
Own the development, delivery and continuous evolution of Digital Storefront's centralized Power BI dashboard, providing intuitive, scalable self-service reporting for Global and Segment teams
Establish and manage a prioritized reporting roadmap, incorporating new data sources, metrics and analytical capabilities as Digital Storefront evolves
Partner with Measurements & Insights, AI & Data Office and Technology to ensure reliable data integration, quality, governance and reporting standards
Leverage AI and automation to enhance monitoring, detect anomalies, accelerate insight generation and improve reporting efficiency
Post-Launch Performance & Hypercare
Own daily/weekly performance oversight and reporting throughout the four-week hypercare period following each new Digital Storefront Cloud site launch, ensuring measurement plans and baselines are established before go-live
Proactively identify performance issues, anomalies and optimization opportunities across customer experience, digital journeys, accessibility, site health and application monitoring
Coordinate investigation and resolution with the appropriate stakeholders, including Technology, Global Digital Content Operations, MarTech, Accessibility, Design, Measurement & Insights and AI & Data Office, ensuring clear ownership, urgency and visibility into progress
Support a structured transition to Market and Segment ownership, ensuring outstanding issues and ongoing reporting accountabilities are clearly understood
Insights, Optimization & Performance Management
Establish a continuous performance management discipline that proactively identifies emerging issues, risks and opportunities, ensuring insights translate into timely, accountable action
Partner with Global and Segment Product Owners, Measurement & Insights and business stakeholders to uncover customer journey friction, identify optimization opportunities and prioritize improvements
Establish an insight-to-action operating model that tracks recommendations, ownership, actions taken and measurable outcomes
Deliver monthly Digital Storefront performance reporting, consolidating Global and Segment results, emerging trends, actions underway and progress against strategic KPIs
Transformation & AI Value Measurement
Serve as Digital Storefront's measurement expert, partnering with Strategy & Transformation to identify, quantify and demonstrate the value created through platform modernization, enterprise capabilities, standardization, reuse and operational transformation
Collaborate on the development of credible measurement approaches and value models, contributing Digital Storefront expertise while aligning with enterprise value realization methodologies led by Strategy & Transformation
Define and implement the data capture, baselines, tracking and reporting required to support ongoing benefits measurement and provide reliable, validated performance information
Partner with capability owners to establish meaningful AI value measures that extend beyond time saved to demonstrate improvements in productivity, quality, accuracy, delivery capacity, rework and business outcomes
Work with Strategy & Transformation to connect operational improvements to broader business value and support the ongoing validation and communication of realized benefits
Executive Reporting & Strategic Storytelling
Own Digital Storefront's consolidated performance narrative, connecting customer experience, Segment outcomes, operational performance, transformation progress and value creation into a compelling, ongoing story.
Lead Digital Storefront performance reporting for the Global Marketing Leadership Team (GMLT) and other executive forums, communicating how the program is performing, what is improving, what actions are being taken and what value is being generated
Proactively identify and develop evidence-based impact stories, including AI-enabled transformation, using validated performance results and agreed value measures
Partner with Strategy & Transformation to shape and communicate Digital Storefront's value creation narrative, ensuring alignment with enterprise methodologies and supporting broader ELT-level reporting and storytelling
Leadership & Performance Culture
Build analytics acumen across Global and Segment teams, enabling stakeholders to confidently leverage self-service reporting, interpret performance intelligence and translate insights into decisions
Champion a culture of curiosity, evidence-based decision-making, accountability and urgency around continuous performance improvement
Embed AI and automation into the team's day-to-day practices to continuously improve analytical, reporting and insight-generation capabilities

Required Qualifications

Extensive experience in digital analytics, performance measurement, business intelligence and strategic reporting within a large, complex organization
Demonstrated experience building and leading analytics, business intelligence or performance management teams, with accountability for both strategy and operational delivery
Demonstrated ability to leverage AI, GenAI and automation to advance analytics, performance monitoring, reporting and insight generation, with an understanding of the technical considerations involved in integrating AI-enabled capabilities into workflows
Proven experience developing measurement strategies, KPI frameworks and integrated performance reporting capabilities
Advanced, hands-on Power BI expertise, including dashboard development, data modeling, DAX and data integration
Strong technical acumen across enterprise data architecture, pipelines, analytic platforms and business intelligence, with demonstrated ability to translate business measurement requirements into technical solutions and guide delivery in partnership with architecture, data and engineering teams
Strong understanding of Adobe Analytics and enterprise data ecosystems, including measurement architecture, data quality and downstream reporting requirements
Ability to connect multiple sources of performance intelligence, including customer experience, digital analytics, accessibility and application monitoring, to generate actionable business insights
Experience establishing performance reporting cadences, translating insights into measurable action and influencing cross-functional stakeholders
Experience developing transformation and AI value measurement approaches, including quantifying productivity, quality, efficiency and business outcomes
Exceptional analytical thinking, strategic problem-solving and executive-level data storytelling capabilities
Strong stakeholder influence and collaboration skills across Product, Analytics, Technology, Data, Marketing and Strategy teams
Demonstrated ability to operate strategically while maintaining hands-on accountability for delivering and evolving measurement and reporting capabilities
Experience leveraging AI and automation in day-to-day analytical, reporting and insight-generation practices

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in financial services, insurance or another regulated industry
Familiarity with Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Web SDK, Customer Data Platforms and enterprise digital measurement architectures
Experience measuring AI, GenAI or agentic AI initiatives and their realized business impact
Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio or similar AI-enabled analytics capabilities
Experience supporting enterprise transformation programs, benefits realization and executive reporting
Experience in agile product delivery and federated Global/Segment operating models

When You Join Our Team

We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.
As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

jobs.title: (CAN) Senior Director, Digital Strategy and Media
jobs.description:
Position Summary...
The Senior Director, Digital and Media is responsible for setting and leading Walmart Canada’s enterprise growth marketing strategy across online and offline media, SEO, and customer engagement.

This role is accountable for building an integrated, full-funnel growth engine that drives customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty, and lifetime value across omni-channel and eCommerce businesses, ensuring marketing investments are aligned to core business priorities and deliver measurable impact. Operating as a senior enterprise leader, this role sets growth priorities, governs investment decisions, and establishes performance standards that guide how media and customer engagement drive business outcomes.

What You'll Do...

Define and own Walmart Canada’s holistic growth marketing strategy across Paid Media, SEO, CRM, Walmart Delivery Pass acquisition and retention, and customer lifecycle management, ensuring alignment to enterprise business priorities.
Strategic leadership across owned marketing media investments for both Store and eCommerce, as well as advertiser-funded offsite retail media programs through Walmart Connect, ensuring media strategies are aligned to Walmart Canada business objectives while delivering measurable value for advertising partners.
Set the strategic vision and operating model for Walmart Delivery Pass marketing, including member acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, and value communication, in close partnership with Product and Membership teams.
Lead customer engagement strategy across CRM channels (email, push, in-app, SMS, personalization, and others), defining lifecycle frameworks that drive frequency, retention, lifetime value, and customer advocacy.
Own enterprise SEO strategy across eCommerce, ensuring organic traffic growth complements paid media, improves efficiency, and strengthens long-term customer acquisition.
Own the enterprise measurement vision across media, CRM, SEO, and Walmart Delivery Pass, establishing KPI frameworks, attribution models, experimentation standards, and incrementality approaches that clearly quantify growth impact.
Provide executive oversight of marketing investment across paid media, lifecycle channels, and membership marketing, ensuring disciplined prioritization, trade-off decisions, and ROI optimization.
Serve as a senior marketing leader partnering with eCommerce, Merchandising, Membership, Walmart Connect, Analytics, Finance, Product, and Technology to align growth priorities, roadmaps, and investment decisions.
Leadership of multi-disciplinary internal teams and agency partners across media, customer engagement, SEO, and measurement, establishing modern operating models, performance standards, and capability roadmaps, while building strong talent pipelines and succession plans that scale with business growth.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
15+ years of progressive experience across growth marketing, media, customer engagement, or digital commerce, including senior leadership roles.
Proven experience managing directors and senior leaders across multiple marketing disciplines.
Deep expertise in paid media, SEO, CRM, lifecycle marketing, and membership-based growth models.
Strong understanding of MarTech and AdTech ecosystems, measurement, attribution, experimentation, and privacy-safe data usage.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex performance data into executive-level insights and decisions.
Experience in retail, grocery, subscription, or omni-channel environments strongly preferred.

Leadership Expectations

Respect the Individual:

Builds high-performing teams; seeks, and embraces differences in people, cultures, ideas and experiences; creates a workplace and experiences where all associates feel seen, supported and connected through culture of belonging so associates thrive and perform; drives a positive associate and customer experience for all.

Creates a discipline and focus around developing talent through feedback, coaching, mentoring, and developmental opportunities; builds the talent pipeline, fosters an environment allowing everyone to bring their best selves to work, empowers associates and partners to act in the best interest of the customer and company, and regularly recognizes others’ contributions and accomplishments; supports strategies and drives initiatives that attract and retain the best talent.

Builds strong and trusting relationships with team members and business partners; works collaboratively and cross-functionally to achieve objectives; and communicates and listens attentively, with energy and positivity to motivate, influence, and inspire commitment and action.

Acts With Integrity

Maintains and promotes the highest standards of integrity, ethics and compliance; models the Walmart values and leads by example to foster our culture; supports Walmart’s goal of becoming a regenerative company by taking action to advance opportunity, sustainability, community, and integrity (e.g., creating fair opportunities for associates and suppliers, driving local giving efforts).

Ensures that teams follow the law, our code of conduct and company policies; promotes an environment where associates feel comfortable sharing concerns, and models our culture of non-retaliation; listens to concerns raised by associates and takes action, and enables others to do the same; holds self and teams accountable for achieving results in a way that is consistent with our values.

Acts as an altruistic servant leader and is consistently humble, self-aware.

Serve Our Customers

Delivers expected business results while putting the customer first and consistently applying an omni-merchant mindset and acting with an Every Day Low Cost mindset to drive value and Every Day Low Prices for customers.

Adopts a holistic perspective that considers data, analytics, customer insights, and different parts of the business when making plans and implementing strategies.

Strive For Excellence

Consistently raises the bar and seeks to improve; demonstrates curiosity and a growth mindset; seeks feedback, asks thoughtful questions, and fosters an environment that supports learning, innovation, learning from mistakes, and intelligent risk-taking; and exhibits resilience in the face of setbacks.

Drives continuous improvements, supervises the adoption of new technology, and supports digital disruption in line with Walmart’s business model.

jobs.title: Director, Consumer Marketing Strategy
jobs.description:
We are a Canadian leader in digital automotive solutions. Our flagship brands — AutoTrader.ca
, AutoSync
, Dealertrack Canada and CMS
— help Canadians buy, sell, and finance vehicles with confidence.

AutoTrader.ca
is Canada’s largest automotive marketplace, with over 25 million monthly visits
. Through AutoSync
, we provide software solutions to 3,500+ dealers
, streamlining their operations, marketing, and sales. Dealertrack Canada
is the country’s top automotive financing portal, processing more than 6.5 million credit applications
each year. Collateral Management (CMS
) is a national tech solution that boosts lien and registration services
, recovery services
, and insolvency management
solutions for Canadian
Lenders

As part of AutoScout24 group
, Europe’s largest online car marketplace, we’re shaping the future of automotive retail in Canada and beyond.

Join us on our journey as we bring together the best of Europe and North America to shape the future of automotive retail.

The role

We’re looking for a commercially minded strategy leader to help shape the next phase of consumer growth for AutoTrader and AutoHebdo, two of Canada's leading consumer brands.

This is an opportunity to own the consumer marketing growth agenda and lead a multi-million CA$ budget.
You'll set marketing priorities and drive growth across Performance Marketing, brand, social media and editorial content.

You'll use data and consumer insights to identify opportunities, make investment decisions and drive execution alongside teams in Canada and across the Autonex group.

This is a hands-on strategy role, working closely with the Canadian executive leadership team
on our consumer marketing strategy and execution. You'll report to the VP, Global Consumer Brand and Canada Consumer Marketing, lead a small Canada-based team and steer shared Performance and Analytics teams through cross-functional influence.

Success will depend as much on your ability to influence, challenge and mobilise others as on your own analytical and commercial judgment.
While there will be campaigns to run - this is an analytical data-driven strategy role with a marketing bent, not an integrated campaigns / media planning role.

We're open to different backgrounds.
You might come from strategy consulting, consumer growth or marketing leadership. What matters is your ability to connect data, consumer insight and commercial strategy - and deliver measurable results.

What you'll do

Deeply understand performance drivers.
Proactively go beyond top-line numbers to identify growth drivers, regional and channel differences, and opportunities for improvement.
Lead investment decisions.
Recommend monthly regional and channel spend adjustments based on business priorities, unit economics and performance data.
Steer Performance Marketing, via influence.
Challenge campaign strategies and drive implementation, working with the centrally managed Performance Marketing team.
Shape brand priorities.
Use consumer insights to guide messaging, content and partnerships across Québec and the rest of Canada.
Re-launch and scale social media marketing.
Build and deliver a structured test-and-learn plan, with clear objectives, measurement and resourcing through hiring and/or agencies.
Lead cross-functionally.
Get buy-in on your plan, establish owners, timelines and success measures, and make decisions without waiting for perfect information.
Lead senior business reviews.
Explain drivers of marketing performance, investment choices and recommended actions to senior leaders.
Develop your direct team.
Set priorities, build capabilities, drive hiring and manage agency performance.

What you'll bring

10+ years in data-driven strategy and transformation
, e.g. strategy consulting, in-house marketing or consumer growth, with people management experience.
Strong hands-on analytical skills
, including advanced Excel skills and basic SQL proficiency. Comfortable going beyond dashboards to investigate data directly.
Proven analytical problem-solving
, including directly deaveraging performance, investigating root causes and translating findings into investment decisions.
Strong understanding of Performance Marketing
, including campaign economics, measurement and investment effectiveness.
Good consumer intuition and brand judgment
, with the ability to evaluate creative work, challenge agencies and improve marketing effectiveness.
AI-forward mindset
, actively using AI tools and building simple agents to automate work, save time and improve effectiveness.
A track record of decisive execution
, influencing teams outside your reporting line and delivering measurable results.
Strong leadership and communication skills
, including developing talent and presenting recommendations to senior marketing and non-marketing leaders.

What's in it for you

We understand that there is life at work and life outside of work. Here are a few benefits we all benefit from that support us to be our creative best.

Benefits from Day 1

Gym discounts
Employee and Family Assistance program
Virtual wellness events
Conferences & training budget
Regular internal training programs

Financial planning

Let us help you invest in your future with 3% matching towards your pension and multiple forms of income protection.

For a career where you can drive our business and shape your future, apply now.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring: We use artificial intelligence (“AI”) in our hiring process, including to screen, assess, or select applicants for this position.

Vacancy Status: This job posting is for an existing vacancy.
